verdict.rationale: Zulip documents an integrations directory with over 130 native integrations, hundreds more via Zapier and IFTTT, incoming webhooks, and the option to run existing prebuilt bots. That is a catalog of prebuilt integrations, but nothing shows an admin installing or enabling them from an in-product marketplace; setup appears to go through webhooks, bot configuration or the Botserver. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-app directory with admin install/enable flow, documented installation steps per integration, independent or hands-on corroboration of installing integrations.
